tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Flat rate, unlimited team members, capped at 500 responded conversations/month.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: $62.10/team member/month if billed annually. Includes AI Agent with a monthly included-resolution allowance; overage billed at $0.85 per additional resolution.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 50 billable conversations/month, 50 one-time Lyro AI conversations, 100 Flows visitors/month.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Starting price, scales with usage. 250+ billable conversations/month, 50+ Lyro AI conversations/month. Marked "Popular".

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting price + monthly usage charges on top. Custom conversation limits, dedicated success manager, requires contacting sales for exact pricing.

tiers.name: Lyro AI Agent
tiers.notes: Sold as a separate add-on from the base conversation plans above. Starting price for 50 Lyro AI conversations/month -- a bundle rate, not a per-conversation charge. The separate Premium plan additionally lists "pay-per-resolution billing" as a feature with no published per-resolution rate.
